fixes.target: figure-1: Common tasks like cutting can create very high dust levels
fixes.value: A photo of a worker in a hi-vis yellow jacket and trousers, a helmet and a face mask bending over to cut the ground with a hand-held cut-off saw beside a brick wall. A large cloud of white dust rises from the cut and spreads across the pavement and road, with a barrier and a vehicle in the background.
fixes.reason: Photo with no printed labels; described from what is visible, matching the caption about cutting creating high dust levels.
fixes.evidence: figure-1.png: worker with cut-off saw, thick dust cloud.

fixes.target: figure-3: Water suppression on a cut-off saw
fixes.value: A close-up photo of a hand-held orange cut-off saw held by a worker in yellow gloves and a hi-vis sleeve. A water hose is attached to the saw and runs to the blade guard, and the ground under the blade is wet with grey slurry.
fixes.reason: Photo with no printed labels; the hose and wet ground show the water suppression named in the caption.
fixes.evidence: figure-3.png: saw with hose to blade guard, wet slurry on ground.

fixes.target: figure-4: Wall chasing using on-tool extraction
fixes.value: A photo of a worker crouching beside a block wall, cutting a chase with a red hand-held wall chaser. A thick black extraction hose runs from the tool down to the floor, and the worker wears a white helmet, a respirator mask, gloves and a hi-vis vest.
fixes.reason: Photo with no printed labels; the hose fixed to the tool shows the on-tool extraction named in the caption.
fixes.evidence: figure-4.png: wall chaser with extraction hose, worker with respirator.
